observed_implementation: One optimizer instance advances on both ordinary CE and pseudo updates.
Muon momentum buffer lerps toward current gradient before Nesterov mixing.
Newton-Schulz input casts toBF16 and divides by matrix norm clamped byeps.
Each Muon update applies multiplicative weight decay before parameter addition.
inference: Small pseudo loss or unclipped gradient does not establish small parameter displacement. A zero-gradient optimizer step advances momentum and decay, so it is not an identity control.
